def doc_csv(s: str) -> list:
    if s == '':
        return []
    rows, row, cur = [], [], ''
    i, n, inq = 0, len(s), False
    while i < n:
        ch = s[i]
        if inq:
            if ch == '"':
                if i + 1 < n and s[i + 1] == '"':
                    cur += '"'
                    i += 2
                    continue
                inq = False
                i += 1
                continue
            cur += ch
            i += 1
            continue
        if ch == '"':
            inq = True
            i += 1
            continue
        if ch == ',':
            row.append(cur)
            cur = ''
            i += 1
            continue
        if ch == '\n':
            row.append(cur)
            rows.append(row)
            row, cur = [], ''
            i += 1
            continue
        if ch == '\r':
            i += 1
            continue
        cur += ch
        i += 1
    row.append(cur)
    rows.append(row)
    if rows and rows[-1] == [''] and s.endswith('\n'):
        rows.pop()
    return rows
